rules.description: Features must not import from other features
rules.check: test ! -d app/features || rg -n --no-heading -e "from ['\"]~/features" -e "import\(['\"]~/features" -e "require\(['\"]~/features" -e "export \* from ['\"]~/features" -e "\.\./\.\./features/" app/features --glob '!**/*.test.*' || true
rules.why: Bulletproof layers require shared → features → app flow; cross imports create hidden coupling.
rules.fix: Move the shared code to app/components, app/hooks, app/lib, or app/types and import from ~/<shared> instead.

rules.description: No index.ts barrel re-exports inside features
rules.why: Barrels break Vite tree-shaking and inflate the bundle.
rules.fix: Delete the barrel file and import the target file directly (e.g. ~/features/about/components/story-section).

rules.description: App imports must use ~/ alias, not relative parent paths
rules.check: rg -n "from ['\"]\.\./" app/routes app/components app/hooks app/lib app/types app/utils 2>/dev/null; test ! -d app/features || rg -n "from ['\"]\.\./" app/features; true
rules.what: Relative parent import (../) found in routes/shared/features.
rules.why: The ~/ alias (tsconfig + Vite) keeps imports stable across moves.

rules.description: No invented impact stats, testimonials, or partner logos
rules.check: rg -ni "(testimonial|partner logo|\d+% (reduction|increase)|trusted by [A-Z])" app --glob '!**/*.test.*' | head -20 || true
rules.why: Pre-launch honesty: no verified impact data exists; status is concept/in_development only.
rules.fix: Replace with forward-looking language ('we are developing…') or a brand-coloured placeholder block.

rules.description: Project cards must stay concept/in_development until verified
rules.what: An active/complete project status string was found.
rules.why: Projects are pre-launch; only concept/in_development is honest.
rules.fix: Change status to concept or in_development in the Project object.

rules.description: No react-hooks disables except the two sanctioned cases
rules.why: CONSTRAINTS.md allows only usePrevious render-time read and useIntersectionObserver thresholdKey.
rules.fix: Remove the disable and fix the hooks violation (top-level calls, pure updaters, memoized subscribe/getSnapshot).
